name: Cymulate
what_it_does: Breach-and-attack simulation platform with broad coverage across email, endpoint, network, and cloud. Provides repeatable attack execution useful for validating detection engineering — including detections targeted at Shadow AI egress and AI-related abuse patterns.
what_it_doesnt_do: Not an AI model evaluation tool. The AI-related modules are useful for ecosystem testing (detection, response) rather than for assessing the AI system itself.
best_for: Detection engineering teams validating SOC coverage of AI-related attack patterns
